# Paws Forward

> Dog-rescue fundraising organization. Donate any amount, or get a personal QR and earn 50% of attributed gifts.

## Site
- Home: https://delexoo.github.io/PawsForward/
- Donate: https://delexoo.github.io/PawsForward/donate.html
- Get your QR: https://delexoo.github.io/PawsForward/join.html
- Privacy: https://delexoo.github.io/PawsForward/privacy.html
- Terms: https://delexoo.github.io/PawsForward/terms.html

## Notes
- Payments are processed by Stripe.
- Application data is stored with Supabase.
- Employee portal is for authorized operators only.
